definitions.explanation: A container for holding water, especially one used for keeping fish or aquatic plants.

examples.english: To keep fish in an aquarium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}→金魚：00233_kingyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水槽|すいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飼|か}っている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
examples.english: I keep goldfish in a tank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{水槽|すいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The large tank at the aquarium has various kinds of fish.

notes:
{水槽|すいそう} refers to a container for holding water, especially fish tanks and aquariums. Composed of {水|すい} (water) + {槽|そう} (tank/vessel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水槽|すいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean the tank
- {水槽|すいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put fish in the tank
- {水槽|すいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧: to change the tank water
- ⟦{熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}→熱帯魚：19146_nettaigyo⟧{水槽|すいそう}: tropical fish tank
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{水槽|すいそう}: large tank (as in aquarium exhibits)

USAGE:
Used for home aquariums, pet shop displays, and large tanks at ⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧ (public aquariums). Also used more broadly for any water storage container or reservoir in technical contexts.
